title: DCA11Y-3520 set explicit outline-color on focused checkbox/radio inputs
description:
## Context
Fixes DCA11Y-3520. Replaces PR #5403 (which just realigned fixtures to Chrome 150).

The a11y `outline-contrast-ratio` check reads `getComputedStyle(input).outlineColor`. Verified via probe PR #5404:

| Element | Chrome 150 CI | Chrome 151 local |
|---|---|---|
| dark focused checkbox | `outline-color: rgb(16, 16, 16)` (near-black) | `outline-color: rgb(153, 200, 255)` (light blue) |
| dark focused radio | `outline-color: rgb(16, 16, 16)` | `outline-color: rgb(153, 200, 255)` |

Both browsers compute the same source rule (`outline: 1px auto`) but resolve `outline-color: auto` differently, and on the dark background the Chrome-150 value has near-zero contrast — the check fires, tests go red on every Chrome bump.

## Changes
- `packages/core/src/less/forms-radios-and-checkboxes.less`: `.radio input:focus` and `.checkbox input:focus` now set `outline-color: @aui-focus-ring-color` (theme token `var(--aui-focus)`). The visible focus ring stays the pseudo-element border; this only fixes what the a11y check reads.
- CHANGELOG entry under 9.12.15.

## Testing
- ACCESSIBILITYUNITDARK / ACCESSIBILITYUNITLIGHT plans on this branch. Verifying in-thread.

## Notes
- Probe PR #5404 can be closed once this is verified.
- The inline-dialog fixture edits from #5403 aren't reproduced here — I'll investigate that case separately.
